metadata.description: Step 5 Preview Spark with immutable checkpoint files and an ARM64 runtime. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Per-node peak is an estimate: GPU memory utilization times 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB for runtime/host overhead; reserve is informational, with the platform OS floor accounted separately. Requires exactly 4 Sparks; not runnable on the current two-Spark fleet. Reproduces 0xSero's K4 expert/K8 hybrid-body image and MTP2 launch. Upstream reports 26-30 tokens/s on four Sparks; not measured here.
metadata.title: Step 5 Preview Spark vLLM 4 Sparks
